_comment: Acceptance-gate measurement: does the conformance corpus actually DETECT a
semantics defect, or does it merely execute the code? D-2026-08-01 makes the
corpus the gate for the case-grain redesign, so this is the number that matters.
'all' report every mutant as NoCoverage against the Orleans TestCluster harness
(measured - see the skill), so Stryker tests nothing and reports a false 0%.
With coverage off every mutant runs all 41 scenarios. Measured ~3.3s per mutant
at concurrency 2, plus ~1 min startup - so scope drives the runtime, not a fixed
cost. Time a narrow run before launching the full scope.
